summary: Web Analytics is installed by hand, so the browser makes two calls to Cloudflare (the script and its report), not one request. The Presentation layer now counts providers, not requests: one, Cloudflare. Chained on the afters of 2026-10-26-web-analytics.

changes.before: petición a terceros al cargar una página: la de Cloudflare
changes.after: proveedor de fuera al que llama el navegador: Cloudflare

changes.before: third-party request when a page loads: Cloudflare
changes.after: outside provider the browser calls: Cloudflare

changes.before: Cargar una página hace una sola petición fuera del sitio: el *script* de [`Web Analytics`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/web-analytics/about/), de `Cloudflare`, que cuenta visitas sin cookies y sin identificar a nadie. Fuentes, imágenes y el resto de *scripts* son del propio sitio.
changes.after: Fuera del sitio, el navegador solo llama a `Cloudflare`: descarga el *script* de [`Web Analytics`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/web-analytics/about/) y le envía sus mediciones, sin cookies y sin identificar a nadie. Fuentes, imágenes y el resto de *scripts* son del propio sitio.

changes.before: Loading a page makes one request off the site: the [`Web Analytics`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/web-analytics/about/) script from `Cloudflare`, which counts visits with no cookies and identifies no one. Fonts, images and every other script are the site's own.
changes.after: Outside the site, the browser calls `Cloudflare` and nobody else: it downloads the [`Web Analytics`](https://developers.cloudflare.com/web-analytics/about/) script and sends it its measurements, with no cookies and identifying no one. Fonts, images and every other script are the site's own.
